newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss contribute to international debt relief fund.
newsitem.headline: Swiss contribute to international debt relief fund.

text.p: Switzerland will contribute 40 million Swiss francs ($27.4 million) to an international fund that helps poor countries reduce their debt, the government said on Friday.
The Foreign Economic Affairs Bureau said director Franz Blankart would make the offer at meetings of the World Bank and International Monetary Fund in Washington next week.
Representatives of the major industrialised countries and multilateral institutions agreed in November the speedy implementation of the heavily indebted poor countries' (HIPC) debt initiative.
The initiative was proposed by the World Bank and IMF and was agreed by governments from all over the world in Washington last September.

It aims to enable poor countries with good economic policy performance to sustain development and reduce poverty by providing relief on debts owed to participating multilateral development institutions.
The Swiss statement said three other donor countries had also agreed to finance the fund but it did not name them. ($ = 1.46 Swiss Francs)
